name: DeviceMyCore
title: Device (MY Core)
publisher: Data Team, Digital Health Division, Ministry of Health Malaysia
description: Patient-associated device profile aligned to the IPS device section for implants, prostheses, and clinically relevant assistive devices.

element.definition: Clinically relevant patient-associated device carried in the MY Core baseline and aligned to the IPS device section.
Capture UDI content when available from the implanted or dispensed device.
Manufacturer serial number when it is available to the exchanging systems.

binding.description: Use a globally managed device terminology, consistent with IPS exchanges where available.
